async def create_worktree(repo_root: Path, spec_name: str, task_group: int, base_branch: str, branch_name: str | None = None, role: str | None = None, mode: str | None = None) -> WorkspaceInfo:
Ensure all existing call sites (that do not pass role/mode) remain valid because both new args have defaults

subtasks.title: Implement empty-string normalisation for role and mode inside create_worktree()
details: At the top of create_worktree(), immediately after argument receipt, add:
effective_mode = mode or None   # normalises '' → None
effective_role = role or None   # normalises '' → None
All downstream path and branch derivation logic MUST reference effective_mode/effective_role, not the raw role/mode parameters

subtasks.title: Implement path and branch derivation rules for 2-level and 4-level paths
details: Replace the existing two-line path/branch derivation with the following logic:
if effective_mode is None:
worktree_path = worktrees_root / spec_name / str(task_group)  # 2-level (role silently ignored)
computed_branch = branch_name or f'feature/{spec_name}/{task_group}'
else:
if effective_role is None:
import logging; logging.getLogger('worktree').warning(
f"worktree: mode={effective_mode!r} was provided but role is None/empty for spec={spec_name!r} task_group={task_group} — defaulting role to 'unknown'. Check graph config."
effective_role = 'unknown'
worktree_path = worktrees_root / spec_name / str(task_group) / effective_role / effective_mode  # 4-level
computed_branch = branch_name or f'feature/{spec_name}/{task_group}/{effective_role}/{effective_mode}'

subtasks.title: Populate role and mode fields on the returned WorkspaceInfo
details: When constructing the WorkspaceInfo return value, pass role=effective_role and mode=effective_mode
Note: effective_role is 'unknown' (not None) when mode was set but original role was absent — WorkspaceInfo.role will reflect 'unknown' in that case
When effective_mode is None, effective_role is also normalised to None (even if it was originally set), so WorkspaceInfo.role=None and WorkspaceInfo.mode=None for all 2-level cases
